name: APIG token business-logic flaw
summary: APIG's transfer accounting credits a self-transfer without preserving the sender debit. The attack helper doubled its APIG balance with 28 self-transfers, then spent the inflated balance into two PancakeSwap pairs and removed their USDT and BETH reserves.

loss.notes: The receipt shows APIG/USDT pair 0xefbf31b0ca397d29e9ba3fb37fe3c013ee32871d receive the attacker's 500-USDT input and pay 72,628.575425255057150292 USDT, for 72,128.575425255057150292 USDT of net depletion; APIG/BETH pair 0xb920456aec6e88c68c16c8294688b2b63c81b2ce pays 59.5 BETH. Archive pair balances at the surrounding block boundary reproduce both amounts. The USDT loss includes the 1.5-USDT financing fee paid from victim depletion. BETH uses the closest preceding DefiLlama ETH price point, $1,625.46 at 1694174103.

ageReset.description: APIG is a directly deployed token. Its 18,531-byte runtime is absent one block before creation and has code hash 0x0eb67ad4103b1e19c7d9c66b6bbf1e0df04b80b97d30658f2d027b9cd11ef8f7 at deployment and immediately before exploitation; both EIP-1967 code-selection slots are zero. The self-transfer inflation is in the deployed transfer path and does not depend on later configuration.

sources.note: Reviewed the successful exploit receipt and call trace, commit-pinned reproduction, victim-pair balances, direct creation receipt, archive runtime code, and EIP-1967 slots. The trace calls APIG directly 63 times: 31 transfer and 32 balanceOf calls. Twenty-eight Transfer events have the attack helper as both sender and recipient; their values double from 960.928352699517099745 APIG to 128,973,620,270.111851824923279360 APIG, demonstrating the balance inflation before the helper spends APIG into the two victim pairs. Receipt net flows and surrounding-block archive balances agree on gross depletion of 72,128.575425255057150292 USDT and 59.5 BETH; the 500-USDT attacker input is excluded while its 1.5-USDT financing fee is not deducted. APIG was directly created in block 31,193,822 index 91. Code is absent at block 31,193,821, and the 18,531-byte runtime hashes to 0x0eb67ad4103b1e19c7d9c66b6bbf1e0df04b80b97d30658f2d027b9cd11ef8f7 at creation and immediately before exploitation. Both EIP-1967 slots are zero, and the defect is independent of mutable token settings, so deployment is the latest age reset 1,109,709 seconds before exploitation.

notes: Replaces the seed's rounded attacker-proceeds estimate with exact victim-pair depletion; financing fees remain part of gross loss.
